policy: Frozen before execution; 12 distinct families selected with family-first seed 20261324, one unused input per family, 1–30 MB. Two repetitions, shuffled serial jobs. Equal 60-second external wall limit for both solvers, including parsing/proof output; no BSAT internal CPU cutoff. Binary DRAT for both. Independent checking outside timing, 600 seconds. No concurrent profiling/builds/tests. Only checked answers count.
limitations: A bounded sample of eligible local files, not a full competition evaluation. Two repetitions expose variation but do not establish narrow confidence intervals. Inputs become development data after this screen.
